nodes.long_description:
1. Place the gravel, sand, and soil in the square box in this order, then use a scraper to even out the surface. 
2. Add water to make it more cohesive.
3. Open the oven door and place one of the two strata models in the oven. 
4. Touch the oven door and bake the strata.
5. put on the gloves on the oven rack, then remove the model from the oven and place it in a mold
6. place your hand on the tool handle and turn it.
After activation, turn the handle and observe the earthquake phenomenon.
Learn that the Earth's interior is in constant motion, releasing enormous amounts of energy to the surface, which causes natural phenomena such as earthquakes and volcanoes to occur on the Earth's surface.
nodes.short_description: Delve into the geological process of stratum formation. This visually engaging experiment simulates the natural process of layer formation, offering insights into sedimentary rock formation and the history of Earth's layers.

nodes.long_description: "Dive into the realm of realistic experiments through Virtual Reality (VR). Experience the excitement of conducting actual reactions in a risk-free digital laboratory. Mix substances, observe genuine changes, and engage with lifelike molecular structures—all in an immersive 3D environment. Enhance your learning by interacting with accurate representations of laboratory equipment and substances, all while honing your scientific skills. Explore the world of chemistry in an unprecedented way, where hands-on experimentation meets cutting-edge technology for an educational adventure like no other.
